topic: Transfer of a spouse's unused credits (line 32600): age, pension, disability (self), caregiver for infirm child under 18, current-year tuition up to $5,000

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): Lee, full-time student, no income, $8,000 eligible current-year tuition; transfers the maximum $5,000 to the spouse; federal 14.5% (2025 lowest rate) gives $725. Remaining $3,000 is carried forward by Lee.

sources.l32600: canada.ca Line 32600 – Amounts transferred from your spouse or common-law partner: age amount, pension income amount, disability amount for self, caregiver amount for infirm child under 18, tuition up to $5,000 of current year; not if separated 90+ days including Dec 31 (tax year 2025)
sources.tuition: canada.ca Line 32300 / Schedule 11: only current-year tuition can be transferred; carried-forward amounts cannot
sources.rate: canada.ca federal tax rates 2025: lowest rate 14.5% for 2025 (15% Jan–Jun, 14% from Jul 1)
